3. **CGHS Society Apartments & DDA Flats**: Ready-to-move, freehold, gated society flats in prime Dwarka sectors.
4. **Penthouses & Duplexes**: Exclusive luxury rooftop penthouses with private terrace gardens.
5. **Commercial Properties**: Retail shops, office spaces, and commercial SCO plots in Vardhaman City Mall and surrounding markets.

7. **3D Virtual Tours & Site Visits**: Interactive 3D walk-throughs and organized on-demand physical site visits across Delhi NCR.
